title: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Public
Service Commission Act, 1989 (II of 1989)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 21st November, 2002]
No. Legis 1-21/Law/73-II,
dated 21-11-2002.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of `
Balochistan on 12th November, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Public
Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 3 of Act II of 1989

BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Public
Service Commission Act, 1989 (II of 1989)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 21st November, 2002]
No. Legis 1-21/Law/73-II,
dated 21-11-2002.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of `
Balochistan on 12th November, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Amendment of Section 3 of
Act II of 1989.---In the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 3-
(a) In subsection (3), for the
word "Government" the word "Governor" shall be substituted.
(b) After subsection (3), the
following proviso shall be added;
"Provided
that no person below the age of 55 years shall be appointed as Chairman or a
Member of the Commission."

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 4 of Act II of 1989

BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Public
Service Commission Act, 1989 (II of 1989)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 21st November, 2002]
No. Legis 1-21/Law/73-II,
dated 21-11-2002.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of `
Balochistan on 12th November, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:--
3. Amendment of Section 4 of
Act II of 1989.---In the said Act, for section 4, the following shall be
substituted;---
"(4) Terms of office of
Chairman and Member.
(1) The term of office of the
Chairman or a Member of the Commission shall be five years:
Provided that a Member, who
immediately before , his appointment as Member was holding a post in the
service of Pakistan may be transferred in public interest before the expiry of
his term of office.
(2) The Chairman or a member
may-resign his office by writing under his hand addressed to the
Governor."
